label: reader I/O thread kind (Data Service scheduler)
type: one of the kinds of thread in the Data Service's scheduler thread pool, tunable separately for reader work - the setting Couchbase recommends adjusting for Magma buckets under specific load conditions.
aliases_note: The extraction spelling opened a `data-service:` namespace, which is refused: the registry already has service:data-service as a promoted concept, and a namespace whose name duplicates an existing concept in another namespace makes every id ambiguous about whether the prefix is a subject area or a thing. Filed in the existing `data:` subject area instead.
evidence: **Scheduler**: A pool of threads mainly used for handling I/O. The threads are divided into different kinds.
